full_judgment: 3. The suit was filed seeking declaration of title, confirmation of possession and for a decree of permanent injunction. It was averred in the plaint that the land in suit since petty settlement is known as Bhut Bhuti Nala and Jur Beel and was recorded in C.S. patta No. 89, that during R.S. operation the said land was recorded in the name of Loke Patni and Others as Mahal Shamil Jalkar in patta No 5, that plaintiff Nos. 1-6's predecessor Syed Alim purchased 14 annas share of the land in suit in 1955 and the rest 2 annas share was purchased by plaintiff No. 7, that although at the initial stage of survey the khatian was prepared in the name of Loke Patni and others but in the finally published khatian names of some other persons were also recorded along with the name of Loke Patni and others, that the land in suit gradually silted up and lost its original character i.e. nala and beel and thereby became fit for boro cultivation, that Loke Patni excavated a 'Khal' over the suit land for irrigation purpose and same has been recorded in Dag No. 18, that the land in suit is partly boro land and there is Government khas land by the side of the land in suit and the same has been settled with the cultivators for boro cultivation, that defendant Nos. 1-4 have been contemplating to settle the land in suit to defendant No.5, hence the Suit seeking the relief for declaration of title, confirmation of possession and for permanent injunction.
